text: The authors state that the method requires multiple queries to both LMs, which could be costly with external APIs when scaling to many claims. They also state that both LMs, mainly the examiner, must follow instructions and reason over a relatively long context, a skill mostly shown by models above 10B parameters, so the method may not work as well for smaller models.
title: Limits: many LM queries per claim; needs strong instruction-following examiners
